title: Count Beautiful Substrings I
sourceKind: search-snippets (official URL in results; statement body not fetched)
summary: A substring is beautiful if its number of vowels equals its number of consonants and the product of those counts is divisible by k. Return the number of non-empty beautiful substrings of s.
officialConstraints: 1 <= s.length <= 1000 (from the leetcode.com snippet). The bound on k was not captured by the search, so constraints are incomplete.
